pr_title: planner: correlated column with unique constraint can help to eliminate MaxOneRow
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #10505

Problem Summary: correlated column with unique constraint can help to eliminate MaxOneRow.

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed: Maintain the NotNull flag and use it to eliminate the MaxOneRow operator.

Tests

- Unit test
- Manual test
```
CREATE TABLE `ss` (
  `a` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  UNIQUE KEY `a` (`a`)
);

CREATE TABLE `t` (
  `a` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `b` int(11) DEFAULT NULL
);

tidb> desc select a from t where t.a < (select ss.a from ss where t.a = ss.a);
+------------------------------+----------+-----------+----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| id                           | estRows  | task      | access object        | operator info                                                                   |
+------------------------------+----------+-----------+----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| HashJoin_22                  | 9990.00  | root      |                      | inner join, equal:[eq(test.t.a, test.ss.a)], other cond:lt(test.t.a, test.ss.a) |
| ├─TableReader_25(Build)      | 7992.00  | root      |                      | data:Selection_24                                                               |
| │ └─Selection_24             | 7992.00  | cop[tikv] |                      | lt(test.t.a, test.t.a), not(isnull(test.t.a))                                   |
| │   └─TableFullScan_23       | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t              | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                                                  |
| └─IndexReader_31(Probe)      | 8000.00  | root      |                      | index:Selection_30                                                              |
|   └─Selection_30             | 8000.00  | cop[tikv] |                      | lt(test.ss.a, test.ss.a)                                                        |
|     └─IndexFullScan_29       | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:ss, index:a(a) | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                                                  |
+------------------------------+----------+-----------+----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
7 rows in set (0.00 sec)

```

### Release note

- Correlated column with unique constraint can help to eliminate MaxOneRow.

comments: @XuHuaiyu Do you mean if IndexReader scan a unique index or primary key, `MaxOneRow_17` step should skip?

Eliminating MaxOneRow requires two conditions, unique and not null. If a NOT NULL constraint is applied to the table (`ss`), MaxOneRow has been eliminated without any code changes. eg.
```
tidb > alter table ss modify a int(11) not null default 0;
tidb > desc select a from t where t.a < (select ss.a from ss where t.a = ss.a);
+------------------------------+----------+-----------+----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| id                           | estRows  | task      | access object        | operator info                                                                   |
+------------------------------+----------+-----------+----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| HashJoin_22                  | 9990.00  | root      |                      | inner join, equal:[eq(test.t.a, test.ss.a)], other cond:lt(test.t.a, test.ss.a) |
| ├─TableReader_25(Build)      | 7992.00  | root      |                      | data:Selection_24                                                               |
| │ └─Selection_24             | 7992.00  | cop[tikv] |                      | lt(test.t.a, test.t.a), not(isnull(test.t.a))                                   |
| │   └─TableFullScan_23       | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t              | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                                                  |
| └─IndexReader_31(Probe)      | 8000.00  | root      |                      | index:Selection_30                                                              |
|   └─Selection_30             | 8000.00  | cop[tikv] |                      | lt(test.ss.a, test.ss.a)                                                        |
|     └─IndexFullScan_29       | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:ss, index:a(a) | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                                                  |
+------------------------------+----------+-----------+----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
7 rows in set (0.00 sec)
```

We can infer that `ss.a` is not null after applying the `ss.a = t.a` filter. You can refer to `expressionRewriter` code to see if we can maintain this NotNull flag and use it to eliminate the MaxOneRow operator.
